item.title: Zelenskyy says US-proposed Europe security framework could benefit Putin
item.description: "In my view, this can be dangerous," Zelenskyy told reporters on Friday. "This should not be the main agenda." His comments were embargoed until Saturday ...
item.content:encoded:
Home / World News / Zelenskyy says US-proposed Europe security framework could benefit Putin

Zelenskyy says US-proposed Europe security framework could benefit Putin "In my view, this can be dangerous," Zelenskyy told reporters on Friday. "This should not be the main agenda." His comments were embargoed until Saturday

Volodymyr Zelenskyy (File Photo: Reuters)

AP Kyiv 5 min read Last Updated : Nov 14 2026 | 7:40 PM IST

Listen to This Article

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said the United States had raised the possibility of a new security framework for Europe as part of efforts to end Russia's war in Ukraine, warning that Moscow could use such discussions to weaken Nato and reshape the continent's borders. "In my view, this can be dangerous," Zelenskyy told reporters on Friday. "This should not be the main agenda." His comments were embargoed until Saturday. Zelenskyy also said the United States had asked for the first time whether Ukraine would withdraw from parts of the Donbas region in eastern Ukraine that Russia does not control if Kyiv were admitted to Nato.

He said he believed Moscow was interested in reopening broader questions about European security rather than focusing exclusively on ending the 4 1/2-year war. "(Russian President Vladimir) Putin's desire to change borders in Europe is a fact. I am sure this is part of his concept of revising security guarantees in Europe," he said. "This is dangerous because, in my view, it is precisely things like this that lead to wars or escalations."   European leaders have stressed that decisions about the continent's security must be made by Europeans themselves, warning against allowing Russia to dictate the terms of a new security order or negotiate Nato's future.

Also Read

US must respect India's right to self-defence, oppose terrorism: Blinken

Democrat Senators ask Musk to preserve documents on Starlink in Ukraine

Europe to send diplomat team to Ukraine talks as leaders push for a voice

Europe must show readiness to join Ukraine peace talks, says Russia

US wholesale inflation hits highest annual rate since 2022, PPI rises 6.5%

US raised Donbas withdrawal in exchange for Ukraine's membership in Nato Zelenskyy reiterated that Kyiv would not surrender its territory. Ukraine is discussing a comprehensive security package with its partners that could include specific guarantees from Nato and the European Union, a strong Ukrainian military and financial support for a specified period, he said. It would also include a recovery plan, he said. "If the American side confirms precisely this to us, together with other Nato partners, then I will ask our Ukrainian society what it thinks: do we accept it or not?" Zelenskyy said. He stressed that any arrangement would not involve recognising occupied territories as Russian.

Zelenskyy also rejected the possibility of Ukraine committing to neutrality, saying that would require changing the country's constitution. "If Putin expects Ukraine's neutrality to be enshrined, that's not going to happen," he said. "We're not in Nato right now anyway." Zelenskyy says Europe must decide its own future Zelenskyy warned that broader discussions about Europe's security could allow Putin to seek changes to Nato's military presence, including the withdrawal of American troops. He said Putin had raised similar ideas with then-President Joe Biden in 2021, seeking a redistribution of power in Europe and the world. "I think Putin will bring up Finland and Sweden. I'm sure he will raise the issue of Hungary and the presence of American troops in the Baltic countries," Zelenskyy said.

He said any changes to Europe's security arrangements must be decided by European Nato members only after the war ends. "The sequence should be as follows: a ceasefire, an end to the war in Ukraine, and security guarantees for Ukraine," he said. "There can be no security guarantees in Europe, or for Europe, without Ukraine." Energy ceasefire and prisoner exchanges are priorities Zelenskyy said Ukraine's priorities in the Abu Dhabi negotiations included an energy ceasefire, reopening the Black Sea, prisoner releases and preparations for a meeting between leaders to end the war. He said Russian negotiators lacked authority to decide on several issues and that Moscow was unwilling to accept an energy ceasefire.

"At the meeting in Abu Dhabi, the Russian delegation said they didn't have a mandate to decide this issue, but we can also see that they are unwilling," he said, adding that negotiators had been told to resolve ceasefire questions directly with Putin. Zelenskyy said discussions in Moscow with US negotiators resulted in an agreement on a prisoner exchange involving more than 1,000 people on each side. The exact number was still being determined, he said, estimating it at 1,200 to 1,300. He also said Washington supported Ukraine's demand that European countries participate directly in future negotiations, rather than remain outside the main negotiating room.

Britain, France, Germany and Italy were among the countries represented at the Abu Dhabi meetings, Zelenskyy said. He expected between three and five European representatives to participate in future discussions. Zelenskyy questions Starshield restrictions Zelenskyy accused SpaceX of imposing restrictions on its Starshield satellite system in Russian-occupied Ukrainian territory, saying the limitations were hampering efforts to intercept Russian drones. He said the system's speed had been restricted to a maximum of 161 kph (100 mph) in occupied areas and that the limitations had been in place for five days. Zelenskyy questioned the explanation that the problem was technical, saying the restrictions appeared to have been imposed by SpaceX despite previous assurances from US Secretary of State Marco Rubio that Starshield was more under the control of the US government.

"The current Starshield restrictions suggest that SpaceX imposed them," Zelenskyy said. "That's what our team is telling me. So this doesn't quite line up with what we heard earlier. That's why we need to get to the bottom of all this."   He said the restrictions prevented Ukrainian forces from intercepting Russian jet-powered Shahed drones over occupied territory as they approached from the east, forcing them to wait until the drones reached areas where the limitations did not apply.

(Only the headline and picture of this report may have been reworked by the Business Standard staff; the rest of the content is auto-generated from a syndicated feed.)

item.title: EXCLUSIVE-エヌビディア前ＣＥＯ、中国人女性との関係巡り幹部に事実と異なる説明
item.description:
Max A. Cherney Jeffrey Dastin
[サンフランシスコ １３日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手エ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
EXCLUSIVE-エヌビディア前ＣＥＯ、中国人女性との関係巡り幹部に事実と異なる説明 11/14 15:07 配信

米半導体大手エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアン前最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ、写真中央）は、不倫相手とされる中国人実業家アリス・フアン氏との関係について、ティム・テター法務責任者やアリソン・ワゴンフェルド最高マーケティング責任者ら複数の幹部に事実と異なる説明をしていた。台湾の台北で２０２４年に撮影された、アリス・フアン氏と特定された女性とフアン前ＣＥＯ、提供写真（２０２６年　ロイター）（ロイター） Max A. Cherney　Jeffrey Dastin

[サンフランシスコ １３日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアン前最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は、不倫相手とされる中国人実業家アリス・フアン氏との関係について、ティム・テター法務責任者やアリソン・ワゴンフェルド最高マーケティング責任者ら複数の幹部に事実と異なる説明をしていた。事情に詳しい関係者２人と、ロイターが確認した社内のやり取りで明らかになった。

ロイターは、メッセージをそのまま引用しないことを条件に、１０月の複数のやり取りを確認した。このやり取りを報じるのはロイターが初めて。

フアン氏は１２日、エヌビディアのＣＥＯを辞任した。近年の人工知能（ＡＩ）ブームの中核を担う技術の先駆者として半導体業界の頂点に立った同氏にとって、劇的な転落となった。

同氏は８日の声明で、妻への不貞行為や会社の期待を裏切ったことを謝罪した。声明では、エヌビディアの顧客であるメガスピード・インターナショナルの元幹部、アリス・フアン氏の名前を明示しなかった。米国は同氏について、中国のためにスパイ活動を行っていた可能性を捜査していた。ジェンスン・フアン氏とアリス・フアン氏は同姓だが、親族関係はない。

米紙ニューヨーク・タイムズは今週初め、ジェンスン・フアン氏がエヌビディアの従業員とも不倫関係にあったと報じた。ロイターは１２日、同氏がさらに別の同社従業員とも親密な関係にあったと報じた。

テター氏はコメント要請に回答しなかった。ワゴンフェルド氏からも直ちに回答は得られなかった。ジェンスン・フアン氏の代理人とエヌビディアの広報担当者はコメントを控えた。アリス・フアン氏の名刺に記載された連絡先に電話と電子メールで問い合わせたが、返答はなかった。

匿名を条件に取材に応じた関係者によると、２０２５年秋と２０２６年１０月、報道機関からの問い合わせをきっかけに、エヌビディアの一部幹部がジェンスン・フアン氏とメガスピードおよびアリス・フアン氏との関係に関心を寄せた。ジェンスン・フアン氏はいずれの際も、交流は適切なものだったと説明した。ロイターが確認したのは２６年１０月のやり取りに限られ、２５年のものは確認していない。

ジェンスン・フアン氏は１０月の２件の別々のメッセージで、テター氏やワゴンフェルド氏らエヌビディア幹部に対し、交流は顧客との通常の商取引に伴うものだったと説明した。他のメッセージでも、メガスピードとの交流は通常の業務の範囲内だったと強調した。

関係者によると、ジェンスン・フアン氏は、ニューヨーク・タイムズが２５年１０月にアリス・フアン氏との公の場での面会に注目した記事を掲載した後、同紙に法的措置を取ることについても協議した。

この記事を受け、ジェンスン・フアン氏は２５年、エヌビディアの一部幹部にアリス・フアン氏との交流について説明したが、不倫関係とは説明しなかったという。最終的に、エヌビディアもジェンスン・フアン氏も同紙を提訴しなかった。同紙の広報担当者は、法的な要求は受けていないと述べた。

アリス・フアン氏との関係がいつ親密になったかは不明だ。インターネット上に投稿され、ロイターが検証した写真には、米国や中国などで２人が一緒にいる様子が写っており、古いものは２０２３年１２月にさかのぼる。

エヌビディアの独立取締役らは今月１０日、米法律事務所ワクテル・リプトン・ローゼン・アンド・カッツに独立調査を委託したと発表した。ニューヨーク・タイムズと米紙ウォール・ストリート・ジャーナルが、ジェンスン・フアン氏とアリス・フアン氏の関係や、アリス・フアン氏が中国のためにスパイ活動をしていたという米当局の疑いについて報じたことを受けた措置だ。中国政府は、同氏がスパイだとの見方を否定している。

ロイターは、アリス・フアン氏が中国政府のために活動していたかどうかを独自に確認できていない。

ジェンスン・フアン氏は１０月２９日に公開されたブルームバーグのインタビューで、アリス・フアン氏に関する疑いについて米政府から知らされていなかったと述べた。

エヌビディアの株価は１０月６日に付けた終値ベースの最高値から３０％超下落し、時価総額は１兆８０００億ドル超減少した。

Nov 13 : Microsoft said its consumer products services had fully recovered at 4:10 p.m. UTC on Friday (1610 GMT), while it was seeing some sustained recovery for its Microsoft 365 enterprise services.  The technology giant said it was "monitoring the backlog of email messages accrued during this event" before considering the issue with the enterprise services resolved.  "Due to the severity of impact this incident caused, we're monitoring for an extended period to ensure no additional mitigative actions are required," Microsoft said in an update on its service status page.

item.title: US must respect India's right to self-defence, oppose terrorism: Blinken
item.description: "India is a global force," Blinken said, adding that the relationship and shared interests between Washington and New Delhi were "really global in nature".
item.content:encoded:
Home / World News / US must respect India's right to self-defence, oppose terrorism: Blinken

US must respect India's right to self-defence, oppose terrorism: Blinken "India is a global force," Blinken said, adding that the relationship and shared interests between Washington and New Delhi were "really global in nature"

Former US Secretary of State Antony Blinken (File Photo: Reuters)

Press Trust of India New Delhi 5 min read Last Updated : Nov 14 2026 | 9:00 PM IST

Listen to This Article

The US must respect India's right to defend itself and should maintain a zero-tolerance policy towards terrorism, former US Secretary of State Antony Blinken said on Saturday, while describing Washington's ties with New Delhi and Islamabad as "fundamentally different". "India is a global force," Blinken said, adding that the relationship and shared interests between Washington and New Delhi were "really global in nature". In contrast, the US relationship with Pakistan is "regional," he said during a conversation with Jawed Ashraf, chairman of the India Trade Promotion Organisation, at the Hindustan Times Leadership Summit 2026 in New Delhi. "The relations with Pakistan are regional, and there are still going to be important areas where we need to do things with them, particularly, for example, when it comes to counter-terrorism, but these are fundamentally different relationships," he said.

"We have to have a zero-tolerance policy for terrorism. Period. And that means that we have to have respect for India's right to defend itself," he added. Also Read

Zelenskyy says US-proposed Europe security framework could benefit Putin

US wholesale inflation hits highest annual rate since 2022, PPI rises 6.5%

Trump says ex Apple CEO Cook is 'a legend', should replace Huang at Nvidia

Alembic bets on 30 US drug launches to sustain growth as exclusivity ends premium

Hegseth calls impeachment bid politically motivated, vows to fight removal

Blinken said the US approach must include support for India's efforts to respond to attacks as well as diplomatic efforts to prevent an escalation between New Delhi and Islamabad, the two nuclear-armed neighbours. He added that efforts to prevent escalation were important given the destructive potential of the weapons both countries possess. Reflecting on Washington's past engagement with Islamabad, Blinken said US strategic interests during the Cold War and the war in Afghanistan may have led successive administrations to be less critical of Pakistan's civil-military establishment.

"And there's certainly an opportunity for the United States to do more," he added. On India-US relations, Blinken described the transformation in ties over the past few decades as a shift from estrangement to a strategic partnership, underpinned by shared interests and people-to-people connections. "We moved from estrangement to a genuine and, in some ways, unique partnership, built on a convergence of strategic interests. Of course, it is also underpinned by the profound people-to-people connections between our societies," he said. He identified cooperation in emerging technologies as an important area for the two countries, pointing to collaboration in space, quantum technology and artificial intelligence.

"The next step is tech cooperation, our ability to work in space, tech, quantum, and artificial intelligence," he said. On India's relations with Russia, Blinken acknowledged the partnership's historical depth and said Washington did not expect New Delhi to sever those ties. "There will be places where we don't have the same perspectives. For Russia, we understand there is deep history between India and Russia. So, we don't want them to end it," he said. Blinken, who served as the 71st Secretary of State from 2021 to 2025 under then-President Joe Biden, said the world was at a profound inflection point, citing rapid technological change, inequality and shifting power.

"The speed and profundity of change is beyond anything we've seen, certainly in my lifetime," he said, noting that ChatGPT, an Artificial Intelligence (AI) chatbot, took one month to reach 50 million users, compared with 75 years for the telephone. He said the private sector increasingly drove technological change, while governments struggled to keep pace. Growing inequalities had fuelled a sense among younger people that they were being "left out, left behind", he said. Blinken warned that the US risked weakening its strength by damaging cooperation between the government, universities and research institutions, and by becoming less welcoming to skilled people from abroad.

"The biggest danger I think we face is a huge self-inflicted wound," he said. On US domestic politics, Blinken said the recent midterm results went beyond the usual setback for the party of a sitting president. He attributed the outcome partly to frustration over the cost of living and concerns about corruption. In the November 3 midterm elections, the Democratic Party won majorities in both the House of Representatives and the Senate, shifting control of the US Congress away from Republicans. Blinken described the US-Israeli military campaign against Iran, launched in February by President Donald Trump, as "a war of choice" and said the first Trump administration's withdrawal from the 2015 nuclear agreement with Tehran had contributed to the crisis.

He said the agreement, signed in 2015 and formally known as the Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action (JCPOA), required Iran to ship out 97 per cent of its enriched uranium and placed limits on its centrifuges, while allowing extensive inspections. After the US withdrawal from JCPOA in 2018, Iran accelerated its nuclear programme, Blinken added, saying the ongoing military action would not resolve the issue. "It is very hard to try to force this Iranian regime to capitulate; it is possible to get it to negotiate. And these are very different things," he said. He called for an "off-ramp" to the conflict, warning that escalation could involve attacks on regional infrastructure, US bases and partner countries.

The Strait of Hormuz, he said, had become a major challenge for global energy supplies after not being a problem before the war. Since February, Iran has repeatedly restricted access to the narrow chokepoint, one of the world's busiest oil shipping channels. On the wider West Asia conflict, Blinken said a lasting settlement required resolving the Palestinian question and establishing a sovereign Palestinian state alongside a secure Israel. "There are seven million Jews in Israel. There are seven million Arabs and Palestinians between Israel proper, the West Bank and Gaza. No one is going anywhere despite what extremists on both sides would like to see happen," he said.

"The solution remains, I fully believe, even though this is not a popular view, a secure Israel and a sovereign state of Palestine," he added.

item.title: US loses measles-free status after continued spread of the disease: Report
item.description: The reported decision by the Americas branch of the World Health Organization comes as the US battles the highest number of measles cases it has seen in more than three decades.
item.dc:creator: CNA

US loses measles-free status after continued spread of the disease: Report

The reported decision by the Americas branch of the World Health Organization comes as the US battles the highest number of measles cases it has seen in more than three decades.

The Americas branch of the World Health Organization has reportedly revoked the United States' measles-free status, ending a 26-year run amid continued spread of the disease. (File photo: Reuters/Sebastian Rocandio)

14 Nov 2026 12:21PM

FAST

The Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) has revoked the United States' measles-elimination status, ending a 26-year run after determining the country failed to halt continuous transmission of the highly contagious virus for more than a year, the Wall Street Journal reported on Friday (Nov 13). The international health body did not immediately respond to a request from Reuters for comment on the report, which cited people familiar with the matter. The reported decision by the Americas branch of the World Health Organization (WHO) comes as the US battles the highest number of measles cases it has seen in more than three decades. Some 7,500 people in the US have been infected with measles and 13 have died since 2025. That period coincides with falling immunisation rates and rising vaccine hesitancy under US Health Secretary Robert F Kennedy Jr., who has for years spread doubts, without scientific evidence, about the safety of measles vaccines.

United States Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F Kennedy Jr speaks during an event at the Department of Health and Human Services in Washington DC, US, Sep 1, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Evan Vucci)

As part of its evaluation, PAHO reviewed epidemiological and laboratory evidence submitted by the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention to determine whether the same strain of measles had been circulating in the United States uninterrupted for 12 months or longer, a sign of local transmission rather than imported cases. Canada, Spain and the UK recently lost measles-elimination status after review by WHO experts. The US dropped out of WHO but remains a member of PAHO, its Americas branch. Dr Erica Schwartz, director of the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, told Reuters in an interview before the decision that if the US lost measles elimination, the agency would be doing "the same exact thing," which entails working with states to encourage immunisation. As of Thursday, 5,182 confirmed cases of measles had been reported in 2026 to the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention from 45 states, New York City and the District of Columbia, surpassing last year's total of 2,289, making it one of the country's worst measles resurgences in decades. "It is a fully preventable disease. It is unconscionable that we have this amount of measles," said Noel Brewer, a public health professor at the University of North Carolina. Brewer, who chairs an independent advisory panel on measles, presented the CDC's measles status report along with his group's assessment of that information to PAHO on Tuesday.

A measles alert sign hangs outside the entrance to the Cohen Children's Medical Center in New Hyde Park, New York, US, Mar 14, 2025. (Photo: Reuters/Shannon Stapleton)

That report remains confidential, but a source familiar with the CDC's findings said the agency determined the US had 12 months of continuous transmission of the virus. The US achieved its measles-elimination status in 2000. A country can halt transmission when 95 per cent of its population is vaccinated, creating so-called herd immunity that also protects those unable to receive the vaccine. Two doses of the measles vaccine - by far the best way to prevent infection and transmission - provide 97 per cent protection against the virus, which can cause blindness, deafness, brain damage or death. William Moss, an epidemiology professor at the Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health, said loss of measles elimination was a hit to the United States' reputation as a public health powerhouse. He said it may discourage other countries. For the average American, he added, it means that the United States will continue to have large outbreaks, putting people at risk of disease, hospitalisation and death. To restore measles-elimination status, a country must end transmission and remain free of an outbreak for at least 12 months. The Department of Health and Human Services did not respond to a request for comment.

item.title: 全米空港で約4時間離陸停止、約1万便欠航 サイバー攻撃の証拠今のところないと高官
item.description:
David Shepardson Doyinsola Oladipo Rajesh Kumar Singh
［ワシントン １３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
David Shepardson　Doyinsola Oladipo　Rajesh Kumar Singh

［ワシントン　１３日　ロイター］ - 全米の空港で１３日、約４時間にわたり離陸が停止した。航空管制センターで通信障害が発生し、連邦航空局（ＦＡＡ）が、地上待機命令を出した。全米規模の離陸停止としては２００１年９月１１日の米同時多発攻撃以来、最長。航空アナリストらは、航空会社の運航スケジュールが数日にわたって乱れる可能性を指摘した。

マリン国土安全保障長官は、今回の障害がサイバー攻撃や制御不能な人工知能（ＡＩ）システムによるものだという証拠は今のところないと説明した。

ダフィー米運輸長官によると、米国の空域は東部時間午後８時１５分（１４日０１１５ＧＭＴ、日本時間午前１０時１５分）に再開した。ただ、出発便の運航は段階的に再開され、航空各社が通常運航を取り戻すには時間がかかると警告した。

航空便追跡サイトのフライトレーダー２４によると、米東部時間午後１１時３０分までに１万便近くが欠航。うちデルタ航空とアメリカン航空がそれぞれ２２００便超、ユナイテッド航空が１８００便。主要空港では、駐機場の空きを５時間以上待った機体もあったという。

ダフィー氏によると、問題は午後３時３６分に始まり、航空管制センターでレーダーと通信システムが不安定になった。「スイッチやルーターがデータで過負荷状態になり、ルーターからのデータに不整合が生じ始めた。そのためシステムを停止した」と説明した。ただ、レーダーや通信の機能が完全に失われたことはなく、数千機を安全に着陸させることができたという。

航空会社の関係者２人によると、障害は防衛・通信機器大手Ｌ３ハリス・テクノロジーズが管理する通信網に影響を及ぼしているもようだ。この通信網は、管制官がパイロットとの交信に使う重要な無線周波数を扱っている。 Ｌ３ハリスはコメントの要請に応じなかった。

米国の航空管制システムは、技術の老朽化や設備・通信の問題、数千人規模の管制官不足が問題となっている。今回の障害は、そうした課題を改めて示した。

ダフィー氏は、目先の問題は解消され、飛行の安全は確保されているとした一方、同様の障害を防ぐには老朽化した航空管制システムの抜本的な刷新が必要だと指摘。新システムへの資金を拠出していないとして議会を批判し、近代化に向けて５００億ドルの予算を求めた。

ホワイトハウスと運輸省は１３日の障害発生前、国内の老朽化した空港と航空管制インフラの更新に向け、３０１億ドルの予算を承認するよう議会に要請していた。

マリン氏は、今回の障害がサイバー攻撃やＡＩ暴走によるものだという証拠は今のところ「全くない」と述べた。「機器的な要因によるものとみられる。ただ、調査は続けている」と述べ、国家安全保障局（ＮＳＡ）が国土安全保障省と連携して調査に当たっているとした。

アメリカン航空は、早期の回復に向けて機体と乗員を配置するため、国際線と主要拠点空港以外の地方都市への便を優先して運航していると述べた。

item.title: US flight shutdown exposes deepening air traffic network crisis
item.description: The nationwide flight shutdown on Friday (Nov 13) has exposed longstanding weaknesses in the US air traffic control network, raising questions about whether billions of dollars in modernisation efforts can prevent further disruptions.
item.dc:creator: CNA

World

US flight shutdown exposes deepening air traffic network crisis

The nationwide flight shutdown on Friday (Nov 13) has exposed longstanding weaknesses in the US air traffic control network, raising questions about whether billions of dollars in modernisation efforts can prevent further disruptions.

The Air Traffic Control tower at Chicago O'Hare International Airport, after the US Federal Aviation Administration issued a national ground stop, in Chicago, Illinois, US, Nov 13, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Jim Vondruska)

14 Nov 2026 11:56AM

FAST

CHICAGO: A communications failure that halted flight departures across the United States on Friday (Nov 13) has renewed scrutiny of the country's ageing air traffic control network, raising questions about its resilience even as the government spends billions of dollars to modernise it. The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) ordered a nationwide ground stop , preventing aircraft from departing US airports, following "a communication issue impacting all Air Route Traffic Control Centers", Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said in a post on X. Duffy later attributed the outage to a problem with the FAA's legacy network, saying switches and routers had become overloaded with data and went down. It was not immediately clear what caused the equipment overload. The FAA lifted the ground stop after more than four hours, but Duffy warned that it would take time for air traffic operations to return to full capacity.

More than 1.5 million passengers were scheduled to depart US airports on roughly 11,000 flights after 4pm Eastern Time (2100 GMT), shortly after the ground stop began, according to aviation analytics firm Cirium.

Travellers wait in line at ticket counters at LaGuardia Airport in New York after the US Federal Aviation Administration grounded flights nationwide, on Nov 13, 2026. (Photo: AP/Ryan Murphy)

The shutdown came on the same day the White House and Transportation Department sought another US$30.1 billion from Congress to upgrade airports and air traffic control, including US$10.1 billion for air traffic control modernisation. Much of the system's underlying weakness has been documented for years. The Government Accountability Office reported in 2024 that the FAA had classified 51 of its 138 air traffic control systems as unsustainable and another 54 as potentially unsustainable. Together, they accounted for more than three-quarters of the systems reviewed. FAA Administrator Bryan Bedford told Reuters in September that the agency's more than 300 air traffic facilities operated as technological silos, relying in some cases on decades-old computers and telecommunications systems that cannot communicate seamlessly with one another. Some obsolete equipment requires replacement parts obtained through online auction websites or made using 3D printing. BACKUP SYSTEMS UNDER STRAIN An incident in September demonstrated how one communications failure could be compounded by another. After error messages appeared on a telecommunications circuit serving a Philadelphia air traffic control facility, the FAA's contractor switched to a backup fibre-optic line. A construction crew then accidentally severed that line in New Jersey, contributing to widespread disruption. About 9,500 US flights were delayed or cancelled that day. "When it fails, we just don't have the redundancy that we would get if we had a modern architecture," Bedford said at the time. Friday's shutdown was the first nationwide ground stop since January 2023, when a failure of the FAA system that distributes critical safety notices to pilots halted departures for less than two hours and disrupted more than 10,000 flights.

A person takes a photo of a screen displaying information on delayed and cancelled flights after the US Federal Aviation Administration issued a national ground stop, at Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport in Atlanta, Georgia, US, Nov 13, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Elijah Nouvelage)

Congress approved US$12.5 billion in July 2025 to modernise the country's ageing air traffic control infrastructure, including telecommunications and radar systems. The administration said Friday that 68 per cent of the FAA's legacy copper telecommunications network had been replaced with high-speed fibre. But Bedford warned in September that replacing ageing copper wires with fibre-optic cables alone would not prevent future outages without a modern telecommunications network. The overhaul faces challenges beyond securing money. In September, the Government Accountability Office warned that the FAA lacked a reliable cost estimate and an integrated master schedule for its air traffic control modernisation programme. Instead, as of May, it had 11,389 separate project schedules that were not coordinated, raising the risk of repeated work at the same facilities, delays and cost overruns. The FAA aims to complete the first phase of modernisation by December 2028. But the GAO warned that inadequate planning increased the risk of delays, potentially leaving the agency dependent on outdated systems prone to failure for longer.

item.title: 米中会談、トランプ氏はスパイ疑惑提起しない見通し＝米当局者
item.description:
Trevor Hunnicutt Jasper Ward
[ワシントン １３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Trevor Hunnicutt　Jasper Ward

[ワシントン １３日 ロイター] - 米当局者は１３日、トランプ米大統領が中国の習近平国家主席との会談で、中国のスパイと疑われる女性実業家アリス・フアン氏を巡る問題を取り上げる見通しはないと明らかにした。同氏は、米半導体大手エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアン前最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）と不倫関係にあったとされる。

トランプ氏は４日間のアジア歴訪の一環として、来週に中国の深センで開かれるアジア太平洋経済協力会議（ＡＰＥＣ）首脳会議に合わせて習氏と会談する予定。フアン氏は１２日にエヌビディアのＣＥＯを辞任しており、会談はそのわずか数日後に行われることになる。

半導体は米中関係の主要な対立点となってきたが、当局者によると、トランプ氏は今回の問題を当面、習氏に提起しない見通しだ。

米政権高官の１人は記者団に対し「こうした国家安全保障上の問題や、米国内で進められている調査・捜査の一部について、現時点で中国側に詳しく知らせることは、おそらくないだろう」と述べた。

別の米当局者も「大統領がアリス・フアン氏の問題を取り上げるとは思わない」と語った。

中国政府は、アリス氏がスパイだとの疑惑を否定している。アリス氏には連絡が取れなかった。ロイターは、アリス氏が中国政府のために活動していたかどうかを独自に確認できていない。米司法省は、アリス氏と中国政府との関係について、いかなる結論にも達していないとしている。

item.title: Listing may change 'Tata way', put profits ahead of philanthropy: Noel
item.description: Noel said while 'some people' are proposing a listing for group's holding company, he fears that enlarging the number of shareholders after a listing will shift its focus to profits from philanthropy ...
item.content:encoded:
Home / Companies / News / Listing may change 'Tata way', put profits ahead of philanthropy: Noel

Listing may change 'Tata way', put profits ahead of philanthropy: Noel Noel said while 'some people' are proposing a listing for group's holding company, he fears that enlarging the number of shareholders after a listing will shift its focus to profits from philanthropy

The comments come at a time when ruptures at the top echelons of the country's largest conglomerate are out in the open | Image: Bloomberg

Press Trust of India New Delhi 6 min read Last Updated : Nov 14 2026 | 3:41 PM IST

Listen to This Article

Tata Trusts Chairman Noel Tata on Saturday expressed concern that a proposed public listing of Tata Sons could fundamentally alter the group's traditional business philosophy, warning that a wider shareholder base may eventually place profits ahead of philanthropy.   "My worry is that listing, which is what some people are proposing, will change the Tata way. And one day, if we have 30,000-40,000 shareholders, profit may take precedence over philanthropy. And I think that will fundamentally change the Tata way of working," Noel Tata said at the HT Leadership Summit 2026.   He said Tata Trusts would work with regulators and other stakeholders to find a solution that preserves the group's founding ethos.

"Tata Trusts will play a constructive role with regulators and others to try and find a solution which keeps the Tata way the way it is," he said.   The remarks come against the backdrop of an intensifying tussle between Tata Trusts and the Tata Sons board over the holding company's ownership structure and leadership. Also Read

Sunil D'Souza's elevation as Voltas chairman comes under the lens premium

Tata Sons listing: 'Regulator's verdict not a failure of advocacy' premium

Tata Sons rejects Noel Tata's request for Sept 17 board meeting recording

Tata Sons row: Philanthropy, rule of law not at odds, Parsi priest tells PM premium

Who is Sunil D'Souza, the new Voltas Chairman succeeding Noel Tata?

Tata Trusts, which controls about 66 per cent of Tata Sons - the holding company of the $165 billion Tata Group - has opposed a public listing, while the Shapoorji Pallonji Group, its second-largest shareholder with an 18.37 per cent stake, has backed a stock market float to unlock value from its investment.

The dispute gained momentum after the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) rejected Tata Sons' September 2026 application to surrender its registration as a core investment company, effectively closing a route the group had pursued to avoid mandatory listing as an upper-layer non-banking financial company.   At a September 17 board meeting, Tata Sons decided to initiate steps towards listing in line with RBI regulations and approved a fresh five-year term for Chairman N Chandrasekaran, reversing his August decision not to seek reappointment after February 2027.   Noel Tata opposed both decisions, with the Trusts subsequently questioning the legality of Chandrasekaran's reappointment. The board approved his reappointment by a 4:1 vote.

Emphasising continuity in the group's philosophy, Noel on Saturday said its ownership structure and institutional character had helped preserve its values across generations.   "The owner cannot die, the owner cannot be bought and the owner cannot retire. There is continuity in what happens the Tata way," he said.   The group has historically combined commercial operations with philanthropy and nation-building, with Tata Trusts playing a central role in its institutional framework.   On the group's strategic direction, Noel said there was no question about its broad objectives, but greater discipline was needed in executing large projects and allocating capital.   "Philanthropy on one hand. Nation building on the other. This is independence of leadership and personalities and this will continue. I do not question the direction of what we have done. I question, sometimes, the delivery of what we are doing," he said.

"The question is, do we have the discipline when we execute projects, and not the direction? How will projects with a long gestation period succeed if we don't have discipline? And how will we allocate capital to those projects?" he said.   "So, very clearly, the direction is fine, but we also need discipline in the execution of these very large projects," he added.   Highlighting the group's role in India's industrial development, Noel said Tata companies were participating in emerging sectors such as semiconductors and electric vehicle batteries.   "We are partners in India's development," he said, adding that the group was undertaking its first semiconductor project and setting up its first EV battery plant.

Noel also spoke about the growth of Tata's retail business, particularly Trent, which operates the Westside and Zudio brands.   He said Zudio was launched in 2016 to cater to consumers at the bottom of the economic pyramid by offering aspirational products at affordable prices.   "It was not that this aspiration for better product was only in the top metros or with the wealthy. The aspiration went down all the way. So we said, how can we address in a way the bottom of the pyramid? So in 2016, we launched Zudio to address this bottom of the pyramid with an aspirational product," he said.

The format started with air-conditioned stores of around 6,000 square feet, with prices beginning at ₹199, he said, adding that the starting price point had remained unchanged over the past decade.   On Westside, Noel said the decision to adopt a private-label model gave the company control over the entire value chain, from fabric and product design to retailing.   He said Westside, which began with doubts over whether such a retail format could succeed in India, now operated around 320 stores and was looking at expanding to more than 500.   Attributing the growth partly to rising consumption, he said demand had increased across socio-economic categories and markets over the past decade.

Noel also said the opportunity to address the needs of underserved sections of society had made a deep impression on him after taking over as chairman of Tata Trusts, adding that the experience had given him greater humility about the scale of social challenges in India.   Tata Trusts vice-chairman Venu Srinivasan and other trustees backing a stock market listing of Tata Sons are understood to favour greater transparency, stronger corporate governance and a clearer ownership structure for India's largest business conglomerate.   They argue that listing would subject the holding company to greater public and regulatory scrutiny, institutionalise decision-making and reduce uncertainty over succession and governance in a group whose businesses span multiple sectors. A public listing could also provide a market-determined valuation of Tata Sons and give investors greater visibility into the financial and strategic decisions of the group.

In a November 11 letter to fellow trustee Darius Khambata, Srinivasan and fellow vice-chairman Vijay Singh cited examples such as Novo Nordisk, Hershey, Lundbeck and Demant to argue that companies can remain anchored by charitable foundations while being publicly traded.   They also pointed to listed Tata companies, including TCS, Tata Steel, Tata Power and Tata Motors, which have undertaken long-gestation investments and nation-building projects without compromising their institutional character.   The Trusts would continue to retain their shareholding in Tata Sons and receive dividends to fund philanthropic activities, they argued, adding that greater disclosure would bring discipline rather than constrain the group's long-term ambitions.

item.title: サッカー＝メッシ引退のアルゼンチン、ウルグアイに敗戦 国際親善試合
item.description: ［１３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［１３日　ロイター］ - サッカーの国際親善試合が１３日に各地で行われ、アルゼンチンはホームでウルグアイに１─２で敗れた。

リオネル・メッシの代表引退後初の試合を迎えたアルゼンチンだが、後半３分にオウンゴールで先制を許すと、同８分にも失点。後半２８分にはジャンルカ・プレスティアンニのアシストからフリアン・アルバレスのゴールで１点を返すも、そのまま敗れた。

アルゼンチンはこの後、１７日の国際親善試合でコスタリカをホームに迎える。

サウジアラビアはカタールの首都ドーハで韓国と対戦し、３─２で勝利。オーストラリアはアウェーでカタールに３─０で快勝した。

item.title: テニス＝スビトリナがサバレンカ破り4強、ＷＴＡファイナル
item.description: ［１３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［１３日　ロイター］　 - 女子テニスのシーズン最終戦、ＷＴＡファイナルは１３日、米カリフォルニア州インディアンウェルズでシングルスの１次リーグ最終戦を行い、２組では第６シードのエリナ・スビトリナ（ウクライナ）が第２シードでベラルーシ出身のアリーナ・サバレンカを破り、準決勝進出を決めた。

スビトリナは第１セットの第１ゲームでブレークを許したものの、ブレークバックに成功。さらに相手のサービスゲームを破って逆転し、６─３で先取した。第２セットはサバレンカがサービスブレークで主導権を握り、６─３で取り返して勝負を最終セットに持ち込んだ。

スビトリナは最終セットでサバレンカのサービスゲームを３度ブレークし、６─１で１時間５３分の熱戦を制した。サバレンカ戦では２０２０年以来６年ぶりの白星で、連敗を５で止めた。

スビトリナは１次リーグを２勝１敗の同組２位で通過し、２０１９年以来の準決勝進出。一方、サバレンカは１勝２敗で敗退となった。

すでに同組１位での４強入りを決めていた第３シードでロシア出身のミラ・アンドレエワは、同じくロシア出身のディアナ・シュナイデルに６─２、６─１で快勝。５５分でストレート勝ちを収め、１次リーグを３連勝で終えた。シュナイデルは体調不良のため欠場したカロリナ・ムホバ（チェコ）に代わって出場した。

準決勝ではスビトリナがリンダ・ノスコバ（チェコ）、アンドレエワがジェシカ・ペグラ（米国）と対戦する。

item.title: トランプ氏、19日に中ロ首脳と核削減協議へ 米政府発表
item.description:
Trevor Hunnicutt
[ワシントン １３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Trevor Hunnicutt

[ワシントン １３日　ロイター] - ホワイトハウスは１３日、トランプ米大統領が来週１９日に中国でロシアのプーチン大統領、中国の習近平国家主席と会談し、核兵器の削減について協議すると明らかにした。

ホワイトハウスのオリビア・ウェールズ報道官は記者団との電話会見で「世界の核兵器削減について協議する。トランプ大統領は核兵器の拡散を非常に危険だと考えている」と述べた。

トランプ氏は、初めてとなる３カ国首脳会談で核兵器削減を主要議題にするよう繰り返し主張している。一方、貿易・商業に焦点を当てた首脳会議を主催する中国は、これに反発している。中国は、世界最大規模の核兵器を保有するロシアと米国との核協議を拒んできた。

プーチン氏、習氏、トランプ氏は、中国・深センで開かれるアジア太平洋経済協力会議（ＡＰＥＣ）首脳会議に合わせて会談する見通し。トランプ氏は１６日、フィリピン訪問も含む４日間のアジア歴訪に出発する。

ただ、トランプ政権高官は核問題について「何らかの合意に至るとは見込んでいない」とした上で、「今後、生産的なものとなることを期待する対話の始まりだ」と述べた。

ロシアと中国がトランプ氏との核兵器削減協議に応じる意向があるかどうかは明らかになっていない。

在米中国大使館とロシア大使館は、電子メールによるコメント要請に直ちに回答しなかった。

先の高官によると、トランプ氏は会談で米国とイスラエルによる対イラン戦争も取り上げるが、ロシアのウクライナ侵攻を議題にする予定はない。

トランプ氏は、プーチン氏との個別会談や、イーロン・マスク氏のスペースＸが提供する衛星通信サービスのウクライナによる利用を巡る協議も予定していない。マスク氏はトランプ氏の訪中に同行するが、習氏、プーチン氏との会談には出席しないという。

また、トランプ氏は今回のアジア歴訪中、北朝鮮の金正恩朝鮮労働党総書記とも会談する予定はないという。

FAST

WASHINGTON: The United States Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) lifted a nationwide ground stop on Friday (Nov 13) after a communications failure at air traffic control centres caused chaos at airports and triggered the longest nationwide shutdown since the Sep 11, 2001, attacks. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said US airspace reopened at 8.15pm Eastern Time (0115 GMT), but warned that departures would resume gradually and it would take time for airlines to restore normal operations. "It's going to be slow," Duffy told reporters at the White House. More than 6,600 flights were cancelled and 8,600 delayed, with another 1,500 already cancelled for Sunday, according to FlightRadar24. Aviation analysts said the four-hour nationwide grounding could disrupt airline schedules for days.

Duffy said tens of thousands of passengers were stranded at airports around the country. Three Singapore Airlines (SIA) flights departing the US on Friday were also delayed due to operational issues affecting US airports, the airline said in response to CNA queries. SQ11, operating from Los Angeles to Tokyo-Narita, was delayed for two hours and 30 minutes while SQ25, operating from New York to Frankfurt, was delayed for one hour and 10 minutes. SQ33, operating from San Francisco to Singapore, was also delayed for 43 minutes. The operational issues affecting US airports have been resolved, and there is no impact on other SIA flights, the airline said.  The failure is the latest and most dramatic sign of strain on a US air traffic control system beset by ageing technology, equipment and communications problems and a shortage of several thousand controllers.

Traffic outside the terminal after the US Federal Aviation Administration issued a national ground stop "due to extraordinary circumstances and reasons for safety" following the agency's earlier report of serious air traffic control communications issues at Dulles International Airport, in Dulles, Virginia, US, Nov 13, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Daniel Heuer

Duane Hanson's "The Traveler" statue rests as people wait in Terminal B during a nationwide ground stop at Orlando International Airport in Orlando City, on Nov 13, 2026. (Photo: Getty Images via AFP/Finn Gomez)

Duffy said the trouble began at 3.36 pm when air traffic control centres experienced instability in radar and communications systems. Switches and routers carrying critical data became overloaded, producing inconsistent information and prompting the FAA to halt departures nationwide, he said. "Our switches, our routers actually got overloaded with data and they started to give us inconsistencies in the data from those routers and because of that we shut the system down," Duffy said, adding at no stage did they completely lose radar or communications and were able to safely land thousands of planes. Duffy said the immediate problem had been fixed and that flying was safe, but warned that a broader overhaul of the ageing air traffic control system was needed to prevent similar failures.

United States Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy takes questions as US Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin looks on in the James S Brady Press Briefing Room at the White House in Washington DC, Nov 13, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Elizabeth Frantz)

US$50 BILLION AVIATION OVERHAUL Duffy blamed Congress for failing to fund a new system that he said could prevent such outages, and called for US$50 billion to modernise it. Earlier on Friday, before the outage, the White House and Department of Transportation had urged Congress to approve US$30.1 billion to upgrade the nation's ageing airports and air traffic control infrastructure. "What we have is an incredibly old air traffic control system," Duffy said. "Give us the money to fix it."

A person waits during delays and cancellations at LaGuardia airport on Nov 13, 2026, in the Queens borough of New York City. (Photo: Getty Images via AFP/Adam Gray)

Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin said there was "zero evidence" so far that the outage resulted from a cyberattack or a rogue AI system, although investigators had not ruled out either possibility. "It appears this was mechanically driven, however, we're still looking," Mullin said. The National Security Agency was working with the Department of Homeland Security on the investigation, he added. The outage appeared to be affecting a telecommunications network overseen by L3Harris Technologies, according to two airline officials. The network handles critical radio frequencies used by air traffic controllers to communicate with pilots. L3Harris did not respond to a request for comment. PAIN NOT OVER FOR PASSENGERS Though the ground stop was lifted, the disruption for passengers was far from over. From Boston to Seattle and New York to Los Angeles, passengers crowded departure halls and airline desks as delays and cancellations mounted and aircraft remained parked at gates.

People wait inside a terminal at Dulles International Airport after the US Federal Aviation Administration issues a national ground stop, in Dulles, Virginia, US, Nov 13, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Daniel Heuer)

Thousands of passengers faced being stranded overnight. Edward Kargbo, 50, from West Chester, Pennsylvania, had been scheduled to take a 9pm Ethiopian Airlines flight to Lome, Togo. Instead, he planned to spend the night at the airport before a rescheduled flight at 6am on Saturday. “I have to squat the night here,” he said. “I’m stranded.” Louise Maher, 47, was also caught up in the disruption at Newark after her British Airways flight to London was caught up in the aviation meltdown. “I might cry at some point but not yet,” she said. US airlines will not be required to provide compensation to stranded passengers because the carriers were not responsible for the FAA system failures. The only other nationwide ground stop since the Sep 11 attacks came in January 2023, when the FAA halted domestic departures for about 90 minutes. Investors were already pricing in a financial hit to airlines. Shares of American Airlines, United Airlines and Delta Air Lines fell between 1 per cent and 2 per cent in after-hours trading, while JetBlue Airways dropped about 3 per cent. American Airlines said it was prioritising flights to smaller cities outside its major hubs and international destinations to position aircraft and crews for a faster recovery.

item.title: ＭＬＢ＝Ｒソックス、バウアーズと4年約92.6億円で合意─報道
item.description: ［１３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［１３日　ロイター］ - 米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）のレッドソックスが、今季ワールドシリーズを制したブルワーズのジェーク・バウアーズ内野手（３１）と４年総額５８００万ドル（約９２億６０００万円）の契約で合意したと、米スポーツ専門局ＥＳＰＮが１３日に報じた。

バウアーズはブルワーズでの３年目となった今季、レギュラーシーズン１４４試合に出場し、打率２割６分６厘、２６本塁打、８６打点といずれも自己最高の成績を記録。ドジャースを４連勝で下したナ・リーグ優勝決定シリーズでは最優秀選手（ＭＶＰ）に選ばれた。

ブルワーズはシーズン終了後、バウアーズに１年２３１５万ドルのクオリファイング・オファー（ＱＯ）を提示していた。

バウアーズは２０１８年のメジャーデビュー以降、レイズ、インディアンス（現ガーディアンズ）、マリナーズ、ヤンキース、ブルワーズでプレー。通算７５７試合で打率２割２分３厘、８４本塁打、２９７打点、５０盗塁を記録している。

item.title: サッカー＝ベッカム氏米国サッカー殿堂入り、ラピノー氏とアーツ氏も
item.description: ［１３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［１３日　ロイター］ - 米国サッカー殿堂は１２日、元イングランド代表主将のデービッド・ベッカム氏（５１）、元米国女子代表のミーガン・ラピノー氏（４１）、ジュリー・アーツ氏（３４）らが２０２７年の殿堂入りメンバーに選出されたと発表した。

ベッカム氏は０７年に米メジャーリーグサッカー（ＭＬＳ）のロサンゼルス・ギャラクシーに加入し、１１年と１２年のリーグ制覇に貢献。現在は元アルゼンチン代表リオネル・メッシが所属するインテル・マイアミの共同オーナーを務める。

ラピノー氏とアーツ氏はともに、米国が１５年と１９年の女子ワールドカップ（Ｗ杯）を制した際の主力選手で、資格取得１年目での選出となった。

ラピノー氏は０６年から２３年まで米国代表として２０３試合に出場し、６３得点を記録。１９年の女子Ｗ杯では得点王と最優秀選手に輝き、同年の女子バロンドール（フランス・フットボール誌選定の権威ある年間最優秀選手賞）も受賞した。アーツ氏は代表１２３試合で２０得点を挙げた。

このほか、元米国代表ＦＷジョジー・アルティドール氏（３７）、元同代表監督ローター・オジアンダー氏（８７）、室内サッカーで８００得点以上を挙げたタトゥ氏（６４）も選ばれた。殿堂入り式典は来年４月１６日にテキサス州フリスコで開催される。

item.title: サッカー＝ロナウジーニョ、約11年ぶりに公式戦復帰へ
item.description: ［１３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［１３日　ロイター］ - サッカーの元ブラジル代表ロナウジーニョ（４６）が約１１年ぶりとなる公式戦に出場する。同選手が加入したイタリア・セリエＣのラベンナの監督が明かした。

現役時代の２００３年から０８年まで所属したバルセロナ（スペイン）で世界的な名声を手にしたロナウジーニョは、１５年にフルミネンセ（ブラジル）を退団後、１８年に引退を表明。今年６月にはラベンナと契約し、クラブの出資者にも名を連ねた。

１５年以来公式戦から遠ざかっているロナウジーニョが選手としてピッチに立つのか疑問視する声もあった。しかし、ラベンナは３週間前、ロナウジーニョが１５日に行われるフォルリとのホーム戦で復帰すると発表した。

ラベンナのアンドレア・マンドルリーニ監督は１３日、記者団に対し、「間違いなく、彼は先発で出場する」と明言。続けて、「どのくらいの時間プレーするかは彼と相談するつもりだ。彼は現代サッカー界における偉大な選手の一人で、われわれには結果が必要。われわれは常に３トップの布陣で戦っており、彼もその３人のうちの一人としてプレーする」と述べた。

ホームスタジアムには、観客収容のための仮設スタンドも設置。ロナウジーニョはゴールを決めれば、プロキャリア通算３００得点目となる。

New York sued over law requiring social media 'warning label'

FAST

NEW YORK, Nov 13 : An internet trade group sued New York on Friday, seeking to block a state law requiring social media platforms that contain potentially addictive features to provide state-approved warning labels for users. In a complaint filed in federal court, NetChoice said the law violates the free speech protections of the US Constitution's First Amendment by compelling its members to convey the state's "preferred message" about online safety. The office of New York Attorney General Letitia James, who enforces the state's laws, declined immediate comment. NetChoice has more than 30 members including Alphabet's Google and YouTube, Facebook and Instagram parent Meta Platforms, Snapchat parent Snap and ByteDance's TikTok. It has filed many lawsuits challenging regulation of social media businesses.

Signed by Governor Kathy Hochul last December, the New York law requires social media platforms with infinite scrolling, auto-play and algorithmic feeds to warn about potential harm to younger users. It requires the display of a "warning" from the US Surgeon General that while social media may benefit some young users, "excessive use may be associated with significant mental health harms." The statement is modeled after findings in 2023 by former US Surgeon General Vivek Murthy. NetChoice said New York's law is "designed to block, burden, and browbeat social media users" by subjecting them to the warning when they sign on and after multiple hours of use, with no way to bypass it. "Unlike a static warning on a product label, these warnings repeatedly interrupt users and block access to protected speech," NetChoice said. NetChoice filed a similar lawsuit against California last month. It also said New York's law is similar to a Colorado law that a federal judge blocked in November 2025, citing the First Amendment. Colorado is appealing that decision. New York's law is scheduled to take effect on January 1.

Source: Reuters

item.title: サッカー＝欧州ＮＬ、オランダが7発大勝 ラインデルスがハットトリック
item.description: ［アムステルダム １３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［アムステルダム　１３日　ロイター］　 - サッカーの欧州ネーションズリーグ（ＮＬ）は１３日、各地で１次リーグの試合を行い、リーグＡの２組ではオランダがホームでギリシャに７─０で大勝した。

開始６分にクリセンシオ・サマーフィルのゴールで先制したオランダは、タイアニ・ラインデルスが前半だけでハットトリックを達成。その後、ユリエン・ティンバーの２得点に、ドニエル・マレンもネットを揺らした。

同組のドイツは、敵地でセルビアに３─１で勝利した。前半３分に相手オウンゴールで先手を取ったドイツは、同１４分にフロリアン・ビルツが加点。後半５分には、代表デビュー戦となったブラヤン・グルダが３得点目をマークすると、その後に１点を返されたが、終盤に２選手が退場した相手を振り切った。

勝ち点１１としたオランダが首位に立ち、ドイツは勝ち点８でギリシャと並んだ。３チームは１６日の１次リーグ最終戦で準々決勝進出への２枠を争う。

item.title: 野球＝日本が韓国破り2連勝、宗山が決勝3ラン アジアプロ野球
item.description: ［１３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［１３日　ロイター］ - 野球のアジアプロ野球チャンピオンシップは１３日、東京ドームで１次リーグの試合を行い、日本は韓国を９─５で下して２連勝とし、決勝進出に大きく前進した。

日本は１点を追う三回、正木智也内野手が２試合連続本塁打となる２ランを放ち逆転。六回には小島大河捕手のソロ本塁打で加点し、七回には宗山塁内野手の２ランで５─１とリードを広げた。

八回表には適時打と３ランを浴びて４点差を追いつかれたものの、その裏の２死一、二塁から宗山が２打席連続本塁打となる勝ち越し３ランを右翼席に運び、山口航輝内野手の適時二塁打でさらに１点を加えた。

宗山は５打数３安打５打点と活躍。日本の先発、竹丸和幸投手は４回を５安打１失点、６三振と力投し、５番手の森田駿哉投手が勝利投手となった。

もう１試合では台湾がオーストラリアを６─４で破り、ともに１勝１敗となった。日本は１４日にオーストラリアと対戦する。

大会は２４歳以下かプロ入り３年目までの選手を中心に、２９歳以下のオーバーエイジ枠も３人まで認められる。日本、韓国、台湾、オーストラリアの４チームが１回戦総当たりの１次リーグを戦い、１５日に上位２チームによる決勝と下位２チームによる３位決定戦を行う。

item.title: Bloomberg Businessweek Daily Podcast: Jensen’s Nvidia Departure
item.description:
The people, companies and trends shaping the global economy. Watch Carol and Tim LIVE every day on YouTube: http://bit.ly/3vTiACF
After weeks spent denying the allegations of infidelity and fighting to remain in his job as Nvidia’s chief executive officer, Jensen Huang’s surrender late Wednesday night was unconditional. His usual take-charge demeanor had evaporated, according to a person familiar with the situation, and he’d started using phrases like “whatever” and “I don’t care.” Huang’s admittance to an affair with an alleged spy has had an international ripple effect across the AI and tech industry.
On today’s episode:
Ian King, Bloomberg News US Semiconductors Reporter Cat Barton, Bloomberg News Seoul Bureau Chief Joe Wiesenthal, Bloomberg ‘Odd Lots’ Podcast Co-Host Mark Jacobson, International Spy Museum Historian (Source: Bloomberg)

Nov 13 : Soros Fund Management, the family office of billionaire George Soros, significantly raised its stake in Intel in the third quarter, a regulatory filing showed on Friday. Here are more details: • The investment firm built a 2.83 million-share position valued at $340.3 million as it boosted its exposure to the major PC chip supplier • The fund had held just 100,000 Intel shares at the end of June, according to its previous quarterly disclosure, marking one of the most striking changes in its portfolio

item.title: ゴルフ＝西郷と勝が2打差の4位、岩井明は急浮上 米女子ツアー
item.description: ［１３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［１３日　ロイター］ - 米女子ゴルフのアニカ・ゲインブリッジ・ペリカンは１３日、フロリダ州ベレアのペリカンＧＣ（パー７０）で第２ラウンドを行い、西郷真央と勝みなみが通算１０アンダーの１３０で、首位と２打差の４位につけた。

前日９位の西郷は６バーディー、１ボギーの６５をマークし、順位を５つ上げた。首位で発進した勝は３バーディー、２ボギーの６９で順位を下げた。

２０位で出た吉田優利は５バーディー、１ボギーの６６で回り、通算８アンダーの９位に浮上。前日９７位と出遅れた岩井明愛は９バーディー、ノーボギーの６１をたたき出し、通算７アンダーの１１位まで順位を大きく上げた。

前日２０位の西村優菜も６７で回り、岩井明と並ぶ１１位。岩井千怜は１８位、原英莉花は２５位につけた。古江彩佳は４３位、渋野日向子は５０位。笹生優花、馬場咲希、竹田麗央はいずれも５９位だった。

item.title: サッカー＝マンＵ新監督にポチェッティーノ氏、降格圏脱出へ再建託す
item.description: ［マンチェスター １３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［マンチェスター　１３日　ロイター］ - サッカーのイングランド・プレミアリーグ、マンチェスター・ユナイテッド（マンＵ）は１３日、米国代表を率いるマウリシオ・ポチェッティーノ氏（５４）を新監督に迎えることを決めた。

リーグ優勝２０回を誇るマンＵは、２０１３年を最後に国内リーグの頂点から遠ざかっている。今季はリーグ戦１０試合でわずか１勝の１８位と降格圏に沈み、同時期の順位としては１９８６─８７年シーズン以来の低さ。公式戦１５試合でも３勝にとどまり、最下位クリスタルパレスとの勝ち点差はわずか１となっている。

マンＵはアレックス・ファーガソン元監督の下でプレミアリーグ１３回、欧州チャンピオンズリーグ（ＣＬ）２回の優勝を達成したが、同氏が退任して以降は監督交代を繰り返し、かつての強さを取り戻せていない。

ポチェッティーノ氏は１８日に就任予定。英メディアによると、契約期間は２９年まで、初陣は２２日に敵地で行われるリバプールとの一戦となる。マンＵが同氏を招へいするために米国サッカー連盟へ支払う補償金は１０００万ドル（約１６億円）に上る見通し。米国代表監督としての契約は３０年ワールドカップ（Ｗ杯）まで残っていた。

同氏は若手の育成やチームの組織力強化に定評がある。スペインのエスパニョールで監督としてのキャリアを始め、サウサンプトンで評価を高めると、トットナム（ともにイングランド）ではＣＬの常連へと成長させ、１９年には決勝進出に導いた。

一方、パリ・サンジェルマン（ＰＳＧ）ではフランス１部リーグ優勝を果たしたものの、悲願の欧州制覇には届かず、チェルシー（イングランド）でも主要タイトルを獲得できなかった。

item.title: トランプ氏、19日に中ロ首脳と3カ国会談へ ＡＰＥＣに合わせ＝報道
item.description: [１３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[１３日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領が１９日、中国・深センで開かれるアジア太平洋経済協力会議（ＡＰＥＣ）首脳会議に合わせ、中国の習近平国家主席、ロシアのプーチン大統領と３カ国首脳会談を行うと、米紙ニューヨーク・ポストが１３日報じた。

同紙によると、３者協議では、野心的な核軍縮協定の策定が主な議題となる見通しだが、北朝鮮やイラン戦争についても議論される可能性があるという。

トランプ氏は既に、両首脳と会談する意向を公に示しており、今週、記者団に対し「非核化を含め、多くのことを話し合うつもりだ」と述べていた。

ホワイトハウスおよび在ワシントンの中国大使館はいずれも、コメントの要請に直ちに応じなかった。

item.title: バンス氏、28年大統領選出馬見送り検討か 中間選挙共和敗北で＝報道
item.description: [１３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[１３日 ロイター] - ２０２８年米大統領選の共和党有力候補と目されてきたバンス副大統領が、出馬を見送る可能性を検討しているもようだ。ＣＮＮが１３日、同氏に近い複数の関係者の話として報じた。背景には、先週の中間選挙で共和党が大敗したことがある。

バンス氏は中間選挙後、イラン戦争が共和党敗北の理由だったとの認識を示し、トランプ大統領が進めた対イラン政策との距離を置く姿勢を示した。バンス氏の側近はＣＮＮに対し、「イランとの戦争を終結できなければ、２０２８年に共和党が勝利する見込みはない」と語った。

さらにＣＮＮによると、バンス氏は、ほころびが生じている「ＭＡＧＡ（米国を再び偉大に）」支持層を再び結集させる取り組みを自身が主導すべきかどうかについても疑問を抱いているという。

また、今年第４子が誕生したこともあり、大統領選への出馬について慎重な姿勢を強めているともみられる。

item.title: Match Group Keeping AI Out of Dating
item.description: Match Group is embracing artificial intelligence across its business, but CEO Spencer Rascoff says AI agents won't be allowed to date for users on Tinder, Hinge and its other apps. Rascoff says Match wants its platforms to remain a “human-only zone,” even as the company uses AI to verify identities, improve safety and block harmful messages. He joins Bloomberg Businessweek Daily to discuss where companies should draw the line on AI and how the technology is transforming Match Group. He also weighs ibn on Jensen Huang’s departure from Nvidia and why he thinks companies are ultimately bigger than any one CEO. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル、週間で約2カ月ぶり上昇へ 円は160円近辺で介入警戒
item.description: ［ニューヨーク １３日 ロイター］ - 終盤のニューヨーク外為市場では、週間ベースでドルが約２カ月ぶりの上昇幅となる見...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル、週間で約2カ月ぶり上昇へ　円は160円近辺で介入警戒 11/14 7:14 配信

日本円の為替レートを表示する電子スクリーン。5月12日、都内で撮影。REUTERS/Issei Kato（ロイター） ［ニューヨーク　１３日　ロイター］ - 終盤のニューヨーク外為市場では、週間ベースでドルが約２カ月ぶりの上昇幅となる見通しとなった。連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の大幅利上げ観測を背景に米国債利回りが上昇したことを受け、ドルは１９カ月ぶり高値近辺を維持している。一方、円は１ドル＝１６０円近辺で推移し、市場では日本政府による介入の可能性が警戒されている。

ＦＲＢ当局者のタカ派的な発言や、週内に発表された予想を上回る米インフレ統計を受け、トレーダーはＦＲＢが来月の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で通常より大幅な利上げに踏み切る可能性を見極めようとしている。

バノックバーン・グローバル・フォレックスの市場ストラテジスト、マーク・チャンドラー氏は「底堅い雇用統計と消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）の伸び加速を背景に、ドルは依然として堅調だ」と指摘。その上で、「今週はニューヨーク連銀のウィリアムズ総裁やウォラーＦＲＢ理事を含め、ＦＲＢ当局者から一連のタカ派的発言があった」と述べた。

ＣＭＥのフェドウォッチによると、トレーダーはＦＲＢが来月開催するＦＯＭＣで、約９０％の確率で２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）の利上げを実施するとの見方を織り込んでいる。

主要通貨に対するドル指数は０．１５％高の１０３．３７と、２０２５年４月以来の高値近辺で推移。週間ベースでは９月以来の大きな上昇率となる勢いで、これが実現すれば３週連続の上昇となる。

item.title: ＮＹ市場サマリー（13日）ドル・2年債利回り週間で上昇へ、Ｓ＆Ｐ・ナスダック続落
item.description: ＜為替＞ 週間ベースでドルが約２カ月ぶりの上昇幅となる見通しとなった。連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の大幅利上げ観測を背景に米...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ市場サマリー（13日）ドル・2年債利回り週間で上昇へ、Ｓ＆Ｐ・ナスダック続落 11/14 7:10 配信

＜為替＞　週間ベースでドルが約２カ月ぶりの上昇幅となる見通しとなった。連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の大幅利上げ観測を背景に米国債利回りが上昇したことを受け、ドルは１９カ月ぶり高値近辺を維持している。一方、円は１ドル＝１６０円近辺で推移し、市場では日本政府による介入の可能性が警戒されている。

ＦＲＢ当局者のタカ派的な発言や、週内に発表された予想を上回る米インフレ統計を受け、トレーダーはＦＲＢが来月の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で通常より大幅な利上げに踏み切る可能性を見極めようとしている。

ＣＭＥのフェドウォッチによると、トレーダーはＦＲＢが来月開催するＦＯＭＣで、約９０％の確率で２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）の利上げを実施するとの見方を織り込んでいる。

主要通貨に対するドル指数は０．１５％高の１０３．３７と、２０２５年４月以来の高値近辺で推移。週間ベースでは９月以来の大きな上昇率となる勢いで、これが実現すれば３週連続の上昇となる。

円は１ドル＝１５９．７０円と、９月初旬以来の安値付近で小動きとなり、介入の可能性への懸念が高まった。週間ベースでは約１％下落し、９月以来の大きな下落率となる見通し。

片山さつき財務相は１３日の閣議後会見で、為替動向について「足元で一方的に急激な動きがみられる」との見解を示した上で「米財務省とも緊密な連携を続け、適切に対応していく」と語った。

ユーロは０．２６％安の１．１０３ドル。

ドルは対スイスフランで０．４７％高の０．８３９フランとなり、２週連続の下落に歯止めをかける勢いだ。

暗号資産（仮想通貨）のビットコインは４．２２％安の６万８４６７．２６ドル。イーサリアムは４．０２％安の１９３４．８６ドル。

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

＜債券＞金利動向に敏感な２年債利回りが、週間ベースで約２年ぶりの大幅な上昇率となる見通し。今週は、市場予想を上回る米消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）や米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）当局者によるタカ派的な発言を受け、利上げペースが加速するとの観測が強まった。    １３日発表の１０月米卸売物価指数（ＰＰＩ、最終需要向け財・サービス）は前年比で約４年ぶりの大幅な伸びとなった。ただ、市場予想を下回ったことから、利回りは低下する場面もあった。    ＣＭＥグループのフェドウオッチによると、金融市場では１２月の米連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で０．５％ポイントの利上げが実施される確率を１０％と織り込んでおり、１週間前のゼロから上昇した。    また、来年１月までに累計０．５％ポイントの利上げが実施される確率は６７％と、１週間前の１６％から急上昇。３月までに累計０．７５％ポイントの利上げが行われる確率も、６％から４８％に上昇した。    終盤の取引で、２年債利回りは０．３４ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）上昇の４．８６７％。一時は４．８９２％と、１０月１４日以来の高水準を付けた。週間では、２０２４年１０月第１週以来の大幅な上昇率となる見込み。    指標となる１０年債利回りは４．６４ｂｐ上昇の５．１４９％。一時５．１７４％に上昇し、１０月１４日以来の高水準を記録した。週間ベースの上昇率は昨年４月以来最大となる見通し。    ２・１０年債の利回り格差は２８ｂｐに拡大した。    ＦＲＢ当局者の発言では、ウォラー理事が１０日、米国の１０月のインフレ率が鈍化したとしてもＦＲＢは１２月の会合で利上げを支持する考えを示し、物価情勢が悪化した場合は５０ｂｐの大幅利上げを検討する必要があると述べたことが引き続き材料視されている。    この日は、ボストン地区連銀のコリンズ総裁が、インフレは依然高いとし、「金融政策が向かうべき方向性は明らかで、近く幾分の追加引き締めが適切になる」との認識を示した。    サンフランシスコ地区連銀のデイリー総裁も、ＦＲＢが利上げする必要があるというのが自身の「見方」だと述べた。    シカゴ地区連銀のグールズビー総裁は、ＦＲＢの目標である２％を上回るインフレが、一時的な可能性のあるエネルギーや関税のコストショックの範囲を超えて広がっているとの見方を示した。

米金融・債券市場：[US/BJ]

＜株式＞Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種とナスダック総合が続落して取引を終えた。米半導体大手エヌビディアへの懸念がハイテク株を圧迫した。一方、この日発表されたインフレ指標を受け、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が追加利上げに動くとの見方は変わらなかった。

エヌビディアは２％下落し、週間ベースで６週続落。続落期間は２０１２年１０月以来の長さとなった。

英紙フィナンシャル・タイムズ（ＦＴ）によると、エヌビディアの取締役会が、辞任したジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）の後任探しの一環で、英半導体設計大手アームのレネ・ハースＣＥＯに接触したことが分かった。

足元では値動きが荒くなっているものの、主要株価指数は週間では上昇し、ナスダックとＳ＆Ｐ５００はともに４週続いた下落に歯止めをかけた。週間では、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００が２．５１％高、ナスダックが２．２７％高、ダウが２．０７％高となった。

フィラデルフィア半導体指数は３．４％下落。アドバンスト・マイクロ・デバイシズ（ＡＭＤ）が８．８％安、ブロードコムが４．８％安となり、最大の押し下げ要因となった。

ＡＩ向けクラウドサービスを手掛けるコアウィーブとネビウスも安い。データセンター関連ではＩＲＥＮが６．７％安、アプライド・デジタルが５．８％安となった。

Ｓ＆Ｐ５００情報技術株指数は１．７％下落し、Ｓ＆Ｐの主要１１業種の中で最も不振だった。一方、マイクロソフトは序盤の下げを消し、０．２％高で終了した。「アウトルック」や「チームズ」などで発生した世界的な障害が解消に向かい始めた。

ニューヨーク証券取引所では値下がり銘柄数が値上がり銘柄数を１．２８対１の比率で上回り、ナスダックでも値下がり銘柄数が１．６１対１の比率で上回った。

米取引所の出来高は１６３億８０００万株で、直近２０営業日の平均である１８５億２０００万株を下回った。

米国株式市場：[.NJP]

＜金先物＞　米卸売物価指数（ＰＰＩ）がほぼ予想通りの結果となり、大幅な利上げ観測が後退したことから、金相場は小幅に上昇した。ただ、前日に１年超ぶりの安値を付けた影響で、週間ベースでは下落した。

金現物は午後２時５分（米東部時間、日本時間翌午前４時５分）時点で０．１％高の１オンス＝３８７９．７１ドル。米１２月物先物の清算値はほぼ横ばいの１オンス＝３８８６．３０ドルだった。

ＮＹ貴金属：[GOL/XJ]

＜米原油先物＞下落し、週間ベースでは２週続落の見通しとなった。世界的な供給過剰の拡大を示す兆候が意識されたほか、米政府が9カ月に及ぶ戦争でイランへの封鎖に注力しつつ、経済的な圧力を強めていることも相場の重しとなった。     清算値は、北海ブレント先物が０．０２ドル（０．０２％）高の１バレル＝９５．８４ドル。米ＷＴＩ先物は０．１８ドル（０．２０％）安の８８．５６ドル。    週間ではブレント、ＷＴＩともに約２．５％の下落となる見通し。両指標は前週にそれぞれ１６％、１３％下落していた。    米国とイスラエルによる対イラン戦争に伴う地政学的リスクが低下したことに加え、１３日に発表された国際エネルギー機関（ＩＥＡ）の報告書が、世界的な石油の供給過剰の拡大を示唆したことを受け、市場は大きな転換期を迎えている。

ＮＹＭＥＸエネルギー：[CR/USJ]

item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:

Exclusive-Investors flock to Anthropic IPO but question durability of AI lead

FILE PHOTO: An Anthropic logo is displayed at Moscone Center during the Dreamforce 2026 technology summit in San Francisco, California, US, September 17, 2026. REUTERS/Carlos Barria/File Photo

14 Nov 2026 06:06AM (Updated: 14 Nov 2026 07:30AM)

FAST

Nov 13 : Institutional-investor interest in Anthropic’s initial public offering is outpacing the early days of SpaceX's roadshow, according to two people familiar with the companies’ offerings. The Anthropic roadshow is scheduled to run through next Wednesday, when the AI company is expected to price the $64 billion deal. Anthropic and its investment banks are meeting prospective investors in New York, Boston and San Francisco to gauge demand for the offering, one of the people and a third person familiar with the matter said.  The IPO drew about two times the orders for the shares available by the end of Tuesday, the first day of the roadshow, one of the people said. By the end of Thursday, the book was six times oversubscribed, one other person said. SpaceX’s IPO was two times oversubscribed by the end of its second day of roadshow, Reuters previously reported. While that single-digit subscription rate would be considered modest for many highly anticipated IPOs, bankers and investors said demand is impressive for the Anthropic offering given the size of the IPO. They expect Anthropic's order book to grow substantially as the roadshow progresses, reflecting strong early demand, two of the people said.

Details of the IPO, including the demand for shares, could change, said the people, who spoke on condition of anonymity. Anthropic declined to comment. During the roadshow, investors are grappling with two fundamental questions as they assess the offering and the company's valuation: whether Anthropic can maintain its lead as competitors such as Alphabet’s Google rapidly catch up in developing advanced AI models, and whether its Claude chatbot can maintain its lead beyond coding, in the broader market for knowledge workers. TIME OF UNCERTAINTY IN AI The questions underscore the challenge of valuing a company whose revenue is growing fast but whose long-term competitive position remains uncertain. Investors are trying to determine whether the AI industry will ultimately be dominated by one or two players or support several leading companies, and whether Anthropic can sustain premium pricing if rivals offer comparable models. Meanwhile, investors are also weighing the limitations of the information Anthropic is providing during its IPO roadshow. One investor who attended a roadshow meeting said the company had not provided detailed answers to some of the questions raised. Anthropic declined to comment on the investor's remarks. While companies are not always able to address every investor question during roadshows, some investors remain cautious about an offering at a high valuation amid a broader shakeout in the AI sector, with the limited disclosure leaving some questions unanswered. One of the group meetings during the roadshow also did not include a conference call allowing institutional investors to dial in and ask questions, according to an investor who attended that meeting — a departure from standard roadshow practice. Representatives from Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley largely read from prepared remarks rather than solicit  questions at that meeting, the person added. Morgan Stanley declined to comment. Goldman Sachs did not immediately respond to a request for comment. REVENUE AT CENTER OF VALUATION DEBATE Investors are arriving at widely different estimates of how quickly Anthropic's revenue will grow, creating a broad range of potential valuation outcomes. The key figure underpinning valuation models is Anthropic's projected 2028 revenue, which banks estimate at around $270 billion to $280 billion and use to apply enterprise-value-to-revenue multiples and arrive at their valuation estimates, two of the people familiar with the projections said. For a high-growth company like Anthropic, investors typically give significant weight to future revenue growth when assessing its value. Some sell-side projections put Anthropic's revenue at around $52 billion to $53 billion in 2026, rising to $135 billion to $137 billion in  2027, one of the people said. Certain buy-side projections are running 10 per cent to 15 per cent higher for 2026 and 2027, an investor who has placed an order in the IPO said. But buy-side forecasts also vary significantly. One investor who conducted due diligence on the IPO but decided not to participate has a more conservative outlook that is about 30 per cent below the sell-side estimate for 2028. Differences between sell-side and buy-side forecasts are common. Sell-side analysts' estimates tend to track a company's own projections more closely, while investors may build in more optimistic or conservative assumptions about future growth. Companies, in turn, have an incentive to set conservative targets ahead of an IPO, leaving room to beat estimates and raise expectations after listing. The comparable companies used in the valuation models also reflect the difficulty of finding direct peers for Anthropic. SpaceX and cybersecurity company CrowdStrike are among the names being used as benchmarks, one of the people familiar with the projections said. The focus on Anthropic's projected 2028 revenue contrasts with SpaceX, whose valuation case relied on projected 2029 revenue that some investors viewed as particularly aggressive. Anthropic's valuation debate, by comparison, is anchored in a forecast for a year closer to its expected public listing.

Source: Reuters

item.description:
David Shepardson
[ワシントン １３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
David Shepardson

[ワシントン １３日 ロイター] - 米連邦航空局（ＦＡＡ）は１３日、全米の空港に対し全ての航空機の離陸停止措置を命じた。航空管制センターで通信障害が発生したことが理由。

フライト追跡サービス「FlightAware」によると、この措置により約７０００便が遅延または欠航となった。

飛行中の航空機は着陸できるが、地上にある航空機は離陸できない。

全米規模で出発便が地上待機となる措置が取られるのは、２００１年９月１１日の米同時多発攻撃以降で２回目。前回は２０２３年１月で、国内線の出発便が２時間近く停止された。

item.title: Commentary: Jensen Huang may prove that the ‘irreplaceable CEO’ is a myth
item.description: Jensen Huang's successor will have to figure out how to run a company built around someone who is no longer there, says Beth Kowitt for Bloomberg Opinion.
item.dc:creator: Beth Kowitt
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

Commentary

Commentary: Jensen Huang may prove that the ‘irreplaceable CEO’ is a myth

Jensen Huang's successor will have to figure out how to run a company built around someone who is no longer there, says Beth Kowitt for Bloomberg Opinion.

Jensen Huang, president and CEO of Nvidia, waits for a groundbreaking ceremony for an expansion of Coherent's manufacturing facility to begin on Jun 16, 2026, in Sherman, Texas. (Photo: AP/Jeffrey McWhorter)

Beth Kowitt

Beth Kowitt

14 Nov 2026 06:00AM

FAST

NEW YORK: “He’s irreplaceable,” Larry Ellison said. The year was 2009 and Oracle’s then-chief executive officer was talking about his friend Steve Jobs, who had recently returned to lead Apple after a liver transplant. Pundits would later go on to say the same about Jeff Bezos, that Amazon.com’s founder and CEO had “no viable successor”. (Both companies, of course, would go on to do just fine without their founders.) It’s worth remembering those prophecies as that word - irreplaceable - gets bandied around with abandon about Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, who stepped down Thursday (Nov 12) after nearly a week of turmoil at the company he cofounded and the industry he anchored.  One of many examples: “I believe Jensen is irreplaceable for America’s AI leadership,” Sequoia partner Shaun Maguire posted on X, a sentiment Elon Musk endorsed.

Revelations from the New York Times on Wednesday, that Huang had an extramarital relationship with the company’s vice president of healthcare, made it impossible for the board to let him keep his job. While less shocking than Huang’s earlier admission that he had an affair with a suspected Chinese spy, he had clearly violated the company’s code of conduct to “avoid situations where our actions create a conflict”. Before board members could make the case that Huang was the victim of a honeypot scheme. But there’s no convenient explanation for a relationship with a subordinate.

CAN NVIDIA SURVIVE WITHOUT JENSEN HUANG? The board named CFO Collette Kress as the interim CEO, but now its members will have to plan for a future without Huang at the helm. This appears to be something they had rarely considered before, after allowing Huang to structure the company almost entirely around himself. The question now is whether he had also built it to survive without him. As Harvard Business School professor Rakesh Khurana put it to me: “The difference between a cult and a religion is that one outlasts the other.” At Nvidia, the evidence suggests that Huang created a system much more akin to the former.  The company has no chairman, no number two and no public succession plan. Huang had 60 direct reports whose job it was to quickly carry out his decisions, Bloomberg News has reported. Few other executives had a broad purview or responsibilities and instead focused on narrow products or technologies. Other executives had some public exposure but were always overshadowed by Huang, who delivered hours-long keynotes at events.  On earnings calls, as the Wall Street Journal noted, Huang fielded questions from analysts mostly by himself, leaving scripted comments to others - a regular practice at Nvidia but atypical at other companies. His board lacked the expected heavy hitters for a company of its size and import; other than Huang, it has no sitting CEOs.

Related:

Commentary: Everything Jensen Huang said about China is out the window

Commentary: Jensen Huang is bigger than Nvidia – and it’s a problem

A REAL FAILURE OF LEADERSHIP? None of that necessarily means Huang can’t be replaced. There was no finding another Jobs or Bezos either - they were both singular leaders. But what they did, which appears to be missing at Nvidia, was methodically build companies designed to carry on their doctrines without them. Both created internal structures that institutionalised their ways of operating and thinking that allowed their successors to thrive: Apple’s stock returned nearly 2,800 per cent during Tim Cook’s 15-year tenure as CEO that ended in September; Andy Jassy has overseen a roughly 50 per cent increase since he took over at Amazon in 2021. At Apple, Jobs was a micromanager who was involved in every detail of the company. But he also taught employees to anticipate how he would solve problems. “The organization has been thoroughly trained to think like Steve,” Fortune reported in 2009. “People could envision, ‘This is what Steve would do.'”  He also had a clear number two in Cook, a manufacturing and supply chain guru, who had a trial run as CEO when Jobs was out on medical leave. Jobs made sure it wasn’t always the Steve Jobs show either. Cook and other executives were given public exposure by appearing alongside him on stage and on earnings calls. (It’s worth noting that Cook is being floated as a possible replacement for Huang, including by President Trump.) At Amazon, Bezos turned his management philosophy into an actionable way of operating - a set of leadership principles that Jassy and other executives helped him write. Bezos picked Jassy as his first shadow, a role in which he followed around the CEO for about 18 months. That’s when the two came up with the idea for Amazon Web Services, and then Bezos gave Jassy a wide berth to run it. By the time Jassy was tapped as CEO, he had already run a hugely important and valuable business. Part of the genius of both Bezos and Jobs was that they figured out how to turn their personal capabilities into corporate culture and competencies.  The parallels are hard to find at Nvidia, which is a real failure of leadership by Huang. His successor will have to figure out how to run a company built around someone who is no longer there. That should be one part of Huang’s legacy that no one tries to replicate.

Source: Bloomberg/sk

item.title: Stocks sway as Wall Street heads for a winning week after several turbulent days
item.description: Stocks are mixed in morning trading Friday as Wall Street heads for its first winning week since early October, despite days of big swings led by AI-focused companies.
item.dc:creator: The Associated Press
item.content:encoded: U.S. stocks closed lower Friday as a pullback in big AI-focused companies weighed on the market, capping a turbulent week on Wall Street. The S&P 500 fell 0.4 per cent, but managed to post a 2.5 per cent gain for the week. This marks the benchmark index’s first winning week since October and its biggest weekly gain since August. The Dow Jones Industrial Average recovered from an early slide and eked out a 0.1 per cent gain. The Nasdaq composite fell 0.9 per cent, but also notched its first weekly gain in five weeks. The major indexes have been shaky this week as some of the biggest AI companies pushed and pulled the market. Many of those companies have big stock values with a heavier impact on the market’s gains or losses. The market remained unsteady a day after the AI industry was rocked by the resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. The company has been the face of the AI industry, which has been responsible for much of the gains, and big swings, on Wall Street. Huang stepped down after his affair with a Chinese tech executive raised U.S. national security concerns. Nvidia’s longtime chief financial officer, Colette Kress, will be its interim CEO. The ensuing fallout cost Nvidia’s market cap more than US$600 billion this week. The AI industry’s influence over Wall Street was evident again Friday, as the slump in technology stocks with a big focus on AI weighed on the market, even though more than 60 per cent of the stocks within the S&P 500 rose. Nvidia was again among the heaviest weights and it fell 2 per cent. Broadcom fell 4.8 per cent and Advanced Micro Devices lost 8.8 per cent. Both companies saw their shares surge earlier this week as the management shake-up at Nvidia unfolded. Nvidia in particular has been slipping for weeks amid wider concerns about a potential slowdown for the industry. The big worry has been whether AI will produce enough profit to justify the costly investments and big stock values. “Nvidia’s pullback serves as a reminder of the concentration risk embedded in a market where a small number of mega-cap technology stocks have driven an outsized share of returns,” said Angelo Kourkafas, senior global strategist at Edward Jones, in a research note. Outside of AI, Microsoft rose 0.2 per cent, despite suffering a global outage for its web services that disrupted email accounts and other applications. Among the gainers were healthcare and financial stocks. Eli Lilly and Co. rose 1.3 per cent. Payment processors Visa and Mastercard also closed 1.3 per cent higher. All told, the S&P 500 fell 30.73 points to 7,561.67. The index is up 10.5 per cent so far this year. The Dow gained 50.46 points to 52,347.55, and the Nasdaq gave up 229.82 points to close at 25,136.27. Oil prices swung a day after President Donald Trump said that the U.S. didn’t “need a deal with Iran” even as the conflict in the Middle East drags on. Brent crude, the international standard, initially jumped early Friday before easing. It settled at US$95.84 a barrel. It was trading near US$72 per barrel in late February before the Iran war began. Stocks in Europe were mixed. Treasury yields were mixed in the bond market. The yield on the 10-year Treasury, which influences mortgage rates, rose to 5.15 per cent from 5.10 per cent late Thursday. The yield on the two-year Treasury rose to 4.87 per cent from 4.86 per cent late Thursday. It closely tracks expectations for action from the Federal Reserve, which is expected to raise its benchmark interest rate at its December meeting in an effort to cool stubbornly hot inflation. A report on Friday showed that wholesale inflation cooled a bit last month, but remains very high. The report measures inflation experienced by businesses, before it can reach consumers. Inflation at the consumer level remains stubbornly high at well above 3 per cent. That’s also much higher than the Fed’s preferred target of 2 per cent. Rising energy prices because of the U.S. war with Iran have been fueling inflation. Household budgets are getting squeezed directly by higher gasoline costs, but pricier gas and diesel raise costs for anything that is shipped. Prices for everything from food to clothing have been rising. The latest wholesale inflation report also shows food prices and other costs gaining ground, despite some easing for energy costs. “That suggests inflation is working its way into the broader economy rather than remaining concentrated in the original areas of price pressure,” said Chris Osmond, chief investment officer for Fifth Third Wealth Advisors, in a research note. “If that continues, it becomes much harder for the Fed to simply look through inflation as temporary.” The central bank held rates steady at its last meeting, following a previous rate hike. The latest hot updates on inflation have prompted economists to overwhelmingly expect a rate hike at the upcoming December meeting, with another hike likely to follow in January. Rate hikes by the Fed can cool inflation, but that makes borrowing more expensive and can slow economic growth. ___ Damian J. Troise and Alex Veiga, The Associated Press AP Business Writers Chan Ho-Him and Michelle Chapman contributed to this report.

The incident follows recent security concerns, with US military aircraft moved from British bases reportedly due to threats from Iran.

An F15 is towed from the main runway at RAF Lakenheath, home of the British-based USAF 48th Fighter Wing, on Apr, 22, 2010. (File photo: AP/Alastair Grant)

LONDON: United States Air Force personnel at the RAF Lakenheath base in Britain responded to "suspected unauthorised drone activity" on Friday (Nov 13) evening, although no personnel, aircraft or infrastructure were affected, a US Air Force spokesperson said. "We continue to work closely with our host nation counterparts to ensure the safety and security of our US service members, US and host nation civilians, contractors, and all of our families," the spokesperson added. Britain's Ministry of Defence said US Air Force Security Forces personnel had responded to reports of unauthorised drone activity and that the situation had been resolved. "We are working closely with them to establish the facts. We will provide updates in due course," a ministry spokesperson said in an emailed statement.
